mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_kyc_documents WHERE user_id=#{uid} AND doc_type=#{kind} AND status != 'rejected' AND challenge_code IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_kyc_documents(id,user_id,doc_type,storage_url,status,challenge_code,created_at) VALUES(#{id},#{uid},#{kind},#{url},'pending',#{code},NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE storage_url=VALUES(storage_url),status='pending',reject_reason=NULL, challenge_code=COALESCE(VALUES(challenge_code),challenge_code)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{uid} AND is_admin=1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_profiles SET buyer_verify_status='approved''rejected', buyer_verify_reason=NULL#{reason}, buyer_verified_at=NOW(3)buyer_verified_at WHERE id=#{uid}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_verification_codes WHERE target=#{uid} AND channel='face_purchase_confirm' AND code=#{code} AND used=0 AND expires_at > NOW(3) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_verification_codes SET used=1 WHERE id=#{id} AND used=0 AND expires_at > NOW(3)
